description: Match begins at Hard Rock Stadium.
Foul on Ødegaard, free kick to Norway.
Foul on Bellingham in midfield.
England's first corner of the match.
Kane's free kick from 28 yards is saved.
Norway attacker flagged offside.
Haaland's close-range header is saved by Pickford.
Andreas Schjelderup sends a cross-shot over Pickford from a tight angle. 1-0 Norway.
Sørloth's set-piece effort goes wide.
Ødegaard's shot from 30 yards hits the frame of the goal.
Bellingham's first effort from a corner goes off target.
Half time: Norway 1-0 England (score before Bellingham's stoppage-time equalizer is confirmed on review).
Jude Bellingham latches onto Anthony Gordon's pass, drives into the box and fires low into the corner. 1-1. (45+2')
Norway claim Bellingham's equalizer should be disallowed (goal kick allegedly struck an overhead camera cable); FIFA rules the ball's sensor detected no contact and the goal stands.
Torbjørn Heggem has the ball in the net but it's ruled out for a foul by Haaland on Anderson.
Kristoffer Ajer booked for protesting the referee's decision.
Fredrik Aursnes replaces Julian Ryerson.
Sørloth fails to square to an unmarked Haaland during a 2-v-1 counter-attack.
Antonio Nusa replaces Andreas Schjelderup.
Oscar Bobb replaces Alexander Sørloth.
Foul on Rice/Eze area, free kick to Norway.
Djed Spence replaces Nico O'Reilly.
Saka's wicked low cross across goal finds no England takers.
Morgan Rogers replaces Ezri Konsa.
Full time: Norway 1-1 England after 90 minutes. Match goes to extra time.
Extra time begins.
Leo Østigård replaces Torbjørn Heggem.
Marcus Holmgren Pedersen replaces David Møller Wolfe.
Bellingham reacts quickest to Nyland's spill from substitute Morgan Rogers' long-range effort to force the ball in. 1-2 England (extra time).
Second period of extra time begins.
Jørgen Strand Larsen replaces Erling Haaland.
Berg's shot from 23 yards is saved.
Saka's fast-break effort is saved.
Spence's low drive is saved.
Saka's follow-up effort is blocked.
Dan Burn replaces goalscorer Jude Bellingham late in extra time.
Full time (AET): Norway 1-2 England. England advance to face Argentina in Atlanta.
